title: Eggless farewell cakes for Westmead and Parramatta teams, pickup till 10pm
summary:
Colleague leaving Friday and nobody can confirm the cake has no eggs? That one we can settle.

Every custom cake at our Wigram Street shop in Harris Park is 100% eggless, so a team in Westmead, Parramatta or Granville can order once without polling the office about allergies, vegetarians or Jain colleagues.

We're open 11am to 10pm daily, so someone can finish a shift and collect on the way home. Send the name, the message for the top and a photo reference on WhatsApp. A 6 inch from $39.99 feeds 6 to 8. An 8 inch from $49.99 feeds 12 to 14.

The farewell speech is your job. The cake we can handle. 🎂
keywords: office cake no egg allergy safe for vegetarian colleagues
